title: Donna Kelce Shares Her Thoughts on Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding
summary: Here's what Swift's mother-in-law had to say about the couple's big Madison Square Garden event.
contentText:
Donna Kelce, Travis Kelce’s mom and now Taylor Swift ‘s mother-in-law, is the newlyweds’ first immediate family member to publicly talk about the wedding festivities that took place in New York City at Madison Square Garden Friday night (July 3).

Related

Here’s Everything We Know About Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding So Far

Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding Vows: What Guests Have Revealed

Maren Morris Reveals Custom Gift From Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Wedding

Mama Kelce made an appearance at the city’s annual Macy’s Fourth of July Fireworks event while she was in town to see her son, who’s the tight end for the Kansas City Chiefs, marry the pop superstar. Donna walked the Macy’s red carpet looking quite patriotic on Saturday (July 4), the day after the wedding, wearing an American flag tunic, white trousers, a red statement necklace and red-framed eyeglasses.

She took part in an interview at the Macy’s event, as seen in a video posted on the department store’s Instagram account.

Of course, Mrs. Kelce was asked about Taylor and Travis’ shindig — a late-night celebration at the famed Midtown arena with a reported 1,000 guests who’ve mostly remained tight-lipped about the details.

Instead of completely dodging the question, she did talk about the bride and groom’s big day. She just didn’t offer much of an inside scoop.

“I really can’t say a heck of a lot except it was magical, man. Magical,” Travis’ mom says on camera in the clip below.

View this post on Instagram

The proud mom of two NFL athletes — Travis and his brother Jason Kelce, who was best man at the wedding — also shared a memory of how the Kelce family would celebrate Fourth of July when her sons were children: “I remember I used to take the boys down to Lake Erie and we would watch the fireworks in Euclid, Ohio, and we had the best time,” she said in the interview this weekend.

Donna Kelce attends the 50th Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks at Pier 17 on July 4, 2026 in New York City.

Eugene Gologursky/Getty Images for Macy's, Inc.

Swift and Kelce opted out of having a traditional wedding party with bridesmaids and groomsmen for their ceremony. The Life of a Showgirl hitmaker’s rep shared that the bride simply had her brother, Austin Swift, serve as man of honor while Jason stood by Travis as best man.

Adam Sandler officiated the wedding ceremony, which featured vows that Swift and Kelce wrote themselves. GMA’s George Stephanopoulos, who was in attendance, described the pair’s vows as “everything you would hope for — real, vulnerable, serious and silly, deeply loving.” Another guest, AMC CEO Adam Aron, spilled that their vows were “long, entertaining, personal, charming, emotional, irreverent and endearing explorations by each as to how they met, why they want to be with each other for all eternity, the promises they made in joining their much-beloved two whole families (Kelce’s and Swift’s) as one, and committing to their new mutual life together.”

Though the couple has yet to reveal a wedding portrait, or even a glimpse at Swift’s wedding dress, it’s been confirmed that the bride and groom’s looks were designed by Dior Women’s, Men’s and Haute Couture Collections creative director Jonathan Anderson (who’s also the founder of menswear label JW Anderson).

Music icons Stevie Nicks and Paul McCartney reportedly performed at the reception at Madison Square Garden, which is said to have been transformed with Secret Garden -themed decor.
